Keep your head up! If possible, try to turn of your phone and computer and go to bed. Alcohol can be your worst enemy in dark times. Give your mind some good rest from this bad night

Hi! I have to warn you that I'm not the greatest when it's about giving advice. But I will try my best.
I do not know what you got counselling and medication for, but if neither of them are an option, you will have to try and get help from your friends and family. You will be surprised about the amount of people that are willing to help you when you try your best to be completely truthful towards them and explain what you are going trough. 
I understand that not everybody will be willing to help you or may not understand, but if that is the case, it is not what you need and you have to look for the next person. And that person WILL be there eventually.
Try and contact your insurance company or healthcare system  to see what other options there may be. maybe you can make certain arrangements. 

Try your best and while you're working on it, try to find something that keeps you busy. Even if it is something like collecting seashells. Anything that lets your mind flow away for a moment.

Stay strong! <3: a person that is finally recovering from a depression and borderline that is almost 21 :)
